notes.note: Reviewed merged source delta against both retained parent bindings, not blanket source approval. StationRuntime now forwards the exact selected MCP tool names to token minting; token and server registration/call filters enforce the same selection, without relaxing per-call authority. Contracts export connection-quota, preserving absent provider data and existing native broker/ICE/account boundaries; merged contract table retains both quota and native observation/ICE entries. Generated Station Docs content remains deterministic/static. Reviewed iOS-only lazy intake split and cancellation import owner; protected roots still wait for launch handling. Finite delays are bounded and rechecked; no-expiry schedules no timer. Two long-expiry cases failed on the earlier scheduler and pass with the fix. 84 mounted native-intake/entry/profile tests pass and UI typecheck passes. Entry size measured in one isolated worktree with its own locked dependencies: base 399417 JS gzip, optimized feature 401776 twice, compared with original 403481. The documented 10000-byte limit step restores 8224-byte headroom after removing eager iOS code. Physical Nightly/public fresh enrollment remains unverified.
